comment: Peer signaling — the shared contract fragment every P2P-capable stream app includes.
WebRTC is a data-plane TRANSPORT under HelixStream, not an app: a service opts in by
declaring `includes` and mapping its own open-input / session-output schemas onto the
`peerOpenInput` / `peerSessionOutput` roles below. The signaling itself rides the
ordinary control plane (MQTT gateway), so there is no side channel.
The DEVICE is the offerer (it also creates the DataChannel), so `open` answers with the
SDP offer in its normal response — no extra round trip. The browser replies with its
answer, and both sides trickle ICE candidates, via `signal`. Device -> browser candidates
ride an unsolicited response (empty requestId), which the gateway unicasts to the session
